BiblicalUsage: Peter warns that if men escape the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, and are again entangled and overcome, their latter end is worse than the beginning. The word is the foulness itself, the effect of the stain, and Peter says escaping it is not enough without staying free.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Peter's warning as the sober end of the matter: to know the way out of the world's pollution and then go back into it is worse than never having escaped.
